heading: INT. SKI LODGE - IMPROVISED TRIAGE ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. SKI LODGE - IMPROVISED TRIAGE ROOM - NIGHT
Blizzard shakes the shutters.
The dining hall has been cleared, tables pushed to the walls, a stretcher laid across the cloth of the nearest.
DR. ELSPETH VANTERPOOL, fifties, in a borrowed fleece, leans over WILLA PETTIGREW, thirties, a skier with a deformed shin who clenches a lodge napkin in her teeth.
NURSE BUNMI OYELARAN, twenties, cuts the ski boot with trauma shears while ski patroller JOAQUIM PINTO, forties, braces Willa's shoulders and murmurs nonsense about the weather.
In the corner, a STRANGER in a soaked parka stands by the fireplace.
Nobody asked him in.
He watches the leg, not the face.
Pulse in the foot?
units.name: ELSPETH

units.text: Faint.
units.name: BUNMI

units.text: She's going white.
units.name: JOAQUIM

units.text: Joaquim, keep her talking. Bunmi, traction splint.
units.name: ELSPETH

units.text: The Stranger steps forward, takes the splint from the cabinet, and unfolds it in one smooth motion.
Bunmi blinks.
Elspeth glares.
Who the hell are you?
units.name: ELSPETH

units.text: Damian Kowalczyk. Paramedic. Truck's buried at the pass.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: He kneels.
Elspeth studies him a second, nods once, and shifts her hands to make room.
Willa spits out the napkin.
Is he going to cut it off?
units.name: WILLA

units.text: No. I'm going to pull. You're going to hate me.
units.name: DAMIAN

units.text: Together the three of them lock the leg and take the weight.
The room holds its breath.
